mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_nas (nas_ip, nas_name, nas_identifier, last_user, success_count, fail_count, last_seen) VALUES (#{nasIp}, CONCAT('NAS-', #{nasIp}), #{nasIdentifier}, #{lastUser}, #{success}, #{fail}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE nas_identifier = VALUES(nas_identifier), last_user = VALUES(last_user), success_count = success_count + VALUES(success_count), fail_count = fail_count + VALUES(fail_count), last_seen = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT id, nas_ip, nas_name, nas_identifier, last_user, success_count, fail_count, last_seen, create_time FROM sys_nas ORDER BY last_seen DESC LIMIT 200
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_nas SET nas_name = #{nasName} WHERE nas_ip = #{nasIp}
